purpose: Candidate-only view for two separate pre-freeze annotation-rule passes. Candidate IDs reveal neither the intended gold nor the final accepted set. These are developer/LLM-assisted proxies, not human labels.

blank_work_three_headings.task_object: the user's blank slides/presentation, not a finished script

binary_rule_two_piles.task_object: the user's mixed receipts, not nearby other items
binary_rule_two_piles.completion: stop when the sorting is done

verify_one_named_condition.task_object: the email subject field, not the whole email/body
verify_one_named_condition.condition: project name is contained in the subject

close_one_named_obstacle.obstacle: unused tabs, not a protected file

write_one_atomic_value.task_object: the target blank, not the address field
write_one_atomic_value.limit: entering that date completes the task, not merely one-step reply length
